event: Check whether tests reference the counters at all.

I verified the finding: none of the five items is checked by any test. I searched the repository for references to the interrupt count-incrementor registers outside the RDL and the generated register files. The only hits were the coverage interface (`src/mci/coverage/mci_top_cov_if.sv`) and one mention in the hardware spec doc.

The coverage interface only has coverpoints on the fields, for example line 4810 for the mbox0 ECC uncorrectable one. Those sample values but never fail a test, so I counted them as near misses. I did not find any stimulus or checker for the decrement-by-1, rising-edge increment or one-bit pulse behaviour.

Each item got a "verified" outcome, and the verdict was accepted on the second submission. The first was rejected for recording too few searches.
